title: Refract
landingDeck: A research and predictive-maintenance platform connecting RAG literature synthesis, interactive paper learning, battery analysis, and model validation.
landingHighlights: Moves battery data through quality checks, leakage screening, regression, Random Forest comparison, and visualization in one workflow.
Connects model outputs to evidence synthesized across 10+ technical papers per research session.
Uses a voice research coach to compare a learner's spoken explanation with the source paper and return accuracy-focused feedback.
summary: A research platform for source-grounded paper analysis, interactive comprehension checks, battery data analysis, and predictive-maintenance validation.
problem: Research work often breaks across PDFs, notes, comparison tables, datasets, and analysis notebooks. Once those pieces separate, conclusions become difficult to trace back to source material.
approach: Refract treats the session as the main object. Papers, saved passages, comparison outputs, uploaded files, and analysis runs all belong to the same record.
output: A Next.js and FastAPI application with reader, compare, and statistics surfaces backed by persistent project/session state.

methodology.evaluation: Data-quality checks and leakage screening precede baseline regression and Random Forest comparison; RMSE and literature-linked interpretation are retained with each analysis run.
methodology.boundary: Refract is an active research platform. Current results demonstrate the workflow and recorded analyses, not a production predictive-maintenance service.

role: I designed and built the session model, reader flow, evidence storage, comparison surfaces, and analysis structure.

pageSections.title: A research workspace for keeping evidence and analysis together
pageSections.description: Refract starts from a practical observation: research work becomes fragile when papers, notes, comparison tables, datasets, and model outputs are scattered across separate tools.
pageSections.context: The session is the central record. It stores the research goal, source material, saved evidence, comparisons, uploaded datasets, and statistical runs.

pageSections.title: Research tools lose the links between evidence and conclusions
pageSections.description: Reading, comparison, and analysis often happen in separate tools, which makes later conclusions difficult to trace.
pageSections.markdown:
Research workflows often split reading, note-taking, comparison, and data analysis across different tools. A later conclusion can become difficult to check against the original passage, dataset, or assumption.

Refract makes the research session the primary object. A session stores the research goal, papers, saved evidence, comparison outputs, uploaded datasets, and statistical runs. That shared record preserves the steps needed for later review.

pageSections.title: The session connects the literature and analysis tracks
pageSections.description: The workflow diagram connects two tracks: literature ingestion, reading, and comparison; then dataset upload, profiling, audit, and modeling. Both write to the same session record, so generated interpretations retain their sources and analysis inputs.
pageSections.caption: Workflow overview from the Refract repository README.

pageSections.title: The product is organized around explicit research moves
pageSections.description: Each major surface exists to preserve one kind of work without detaching it from the surrounding session.

pageSections.title: The data model carries the research context forward
pageSections.description: Generated outputs remain attached to their source material, settings, and session state.
pageSections.markdown:
Refract stores the context created as the work evolves. A saved passage, generated comparison, or dataset profile remains attached to the session that produced it, so a later conclusion can be checked against its evidence and settings.

The frontend provides separate reader, comparison, and statistics surfaces. The backend relates papers, extracted evidence, uploaded files, and analysis runs through the session model. Provenance connects a later conclusion to the reading, comparison, and model evaluation steps that produced it.

pageSections.markdown: A research session holds the goal of the work, the relevant papers, extracted evidence, comparisons, and statistical results. This shared state gives later interpretation a complete record of the material and analysis used to reach it.
